speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: Hi Angela. Is now still okay?

speaker: Angela Nurse
text: Now's great. I've got the checklist open. How'd the Ducal call go?

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: Really well, actually. He knows exactly what he wants, which is a gift. Anyway. Where are we?

speaker: Angela Nurse
text: So I just moved us to eighty-five percent. Release notes, store listing, rollout plan, all checked off. The two big ones left are forty-eight hours crash-free and QA sign-off.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: And Balthasar's still good for Thursday at three thirty?

speaker: Angela Nurse
text: Three thirty, yep. He'll sign off then, assuming the old tablet behaves. I'm booking it for the three of us this afternoon.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: Is he running it now? He said eleven.

speaker: Angela Nurse
text: Right now, yeah. All six devices, with Tybalt's branch on the old one. He'll post in the channel when he's done.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: Great. And go or no-go doesn't move?

speaker: Angela Nurse
text: Friday, nine thirty. Unless something catches fire, it doesn't move.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: Let's not set anything on fire.

speaker: Angela Nurse
text: Ha. Noted. And the rollout plan's the boring one we talked about. Ten percent first, then everybody, if the crash numbers stay quiet.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: Boring is good. I like boring this week.

speaker: Angela Nurse
text: Um, the other thing. The announcement. I'd like to draft it so it's ready, but I won't send anything until we've actually said go.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: Yes, perfect. Draft it, send it after the go.

speaker: Angela Nurse
text: That's the plan.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: One ask from me. The old Android 11 tablet, the one that kept crashing. Can we add it to the standing device list? So it gets tested every release, not just when someone remembers it's in the drawer.

speaker: Angela Nurse
text: Oh, good call. That's the one that caught the camera crash. I'll add it today.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: Where does it live, anyway?

speaker: Angela Nurse
text: In my desk drawer. With a sticky note on it that says do not recycle.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: Good. Let's keep it that way for a while.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: Thank you. I left the same note on Tybalt's pull request, for CI.

speaker: Angela Nurse
text: Then I'll match whatever he does. Same tablet on both lists.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: Perfect. Anything you need from me before Friday?

speaker: Angela Nurse
text: Honestly? Just show up at nine thirty. Oh, and if you see anything odd in the crash digest, forward it to me. Don't just, you know, file it in your head.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: Ha. Fair. Will do.

speaker: Angela Nurse
text: Okay, that's me. Go write your spec.

speaker: Juliet Capulet
text: Going. Thanks, Angela.
